items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I played out there with Dylan and the B. Today.

ctx.x: And Manny's Tavern too, Benefit and St. Rocky, I heard you.
Oh, yeah. Well, I played out there with Dylan and the B. Today. Yeah. I had a trombone.
Did you ever have a trombone on these little trombones? No.
